identity.title: [v0.91.8][ci][tooling] Route C-SDLC proof and FastWork builds correctly

values.summary: Prepare and bind; write failing route/wrapper fixtures; implement the smallest classifier, standalone job, aggregate, and wrapper changes; validate and review; publish, merge, post-merge validate, and close out.

steps.action: Prepare, review, initialize, bind, and establish exact failing regressions
Implement focused classifier and portable wrapper behavior
Wire the standalone job and truthful stable aggregates
Run focused proof, exact-revision review, and fix every actionable finding
Publish, shepherd hosted checks, merge, post-merge validate, and close out

invariants: Selected proof jobs are fail-closed in stable aggregates
No C-SDLC-only path launches unrelated ADL workspace or Runtime coverage
Existing non-C-SDLC route semantics and required-check names remain
risks: A selected standalone lane could be omitted from the stable aggregate
A mixed diff could accidentally suppress required ADL or Runtime proof
A local wrapper could silently fall back to an unwritable or repository-local Cargo home
Workflow changes could trigger their own full coverage route
stop_conditions: Any need to alter Runtime behavior, C-SDLC lifecycle semantics, or ADL-v2 semantics
Any need for AWS, credentials, or a new dependency
Any solution requiring a CI or validation-manager redesign
